text: {"decision": "reject", "reason": "posts.LastEditorUserId semantically references users (it coexists with OwnerUserId and the comments table has its own UserId column), while comments.Id is the comment's own primary key, so the 87% containment is chance overlap between dense integer ID ranges (comments.Id densely spans 1–221292 covering nearly all values up to the source's max of 55733) with only 3.3% coverage of the target."}
